newsitem.title: LEBANON: Banque Audi profits up 52.5 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Banque Audi profits up 52.5 pct in 1996.

text.p: Lebanon's Banque Audi reported on Monday that its profits rose 52.5 percent in 1996 to 30.71 billion Lebanese pounds ($19.8 million) from 20.14 billion pounds in 1995.
The bank issued a press release detailing its consolidated audited 1996 balance sheet and stating that assets, customer deposits, loans and equity all rose sharply over 1995.
Assets rose 35.3 percent, deposits 27.9 percent, loans 32.1 percent and equity 26 percent, it said.
Banque Audi began trading 30 percent of its shares on the Beirut Stock Exchange on January 20 and they have since become the most active on the market.
Other details issued by the bank included an increase in earnings per share to $1.43 in 1996 from $0.96 in 1995.
